# pyduck-janitor

> DuckDB-backed pyjanitor for lazy data cleaning, database metrics, temporal
> analysis, graph workflows, and snapshot comparison.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): installation, quickstart, and capability overview
- [Agent Guide](docs/agent-guide.md): API map, workflows, and boundaries
- [API Reference](docs/api/functions.md): signatures and runnable examples
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history and compatibility notes
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and validation workflow

## Source map

- `pyduck_janitor/duck_janitor.py`: core relation wrapper and public methods
- `pyduck_janitor/cleaning_ops.py`: core cleaning verbs
- `pyduck_janitor/cleaning_ops_extended.py`: extended cleaning/reshape verbs
- `pyduck_janitor/io_ops.py`: native output and write-back (parquet/csv/json/table/arrow/polars)
- `pyduck_janitor/sampling.py`: `USING SAMPLE`, approximate aggregates, Python UDF registration
- `pyduck_janitor/nested_ops.py`: STRUCT/LIST/JSON verbs
- `pyduck_janitor/_sqlutil.py`: shared identifier quoting, literal rendering, temp-name allocation
- `pyduck_janitor/bins_opt.py`: supervised binning (`optimize_bins_to_target`); guide at `docs/supervised_binning.md`
- `pyduck_janitor/embeddings.py`: optional vector helpers
- `pyduck_janitor/text_ops.py`: text and full-text-search helpers
- `pyduck_janitor/extensions.py`: lazy DuckDB extension loading
- `scripts/generate_api_docs.py`: executable API documentation generator
- `tests/`: regression and extension tests

## Key public APIs

`from_database`, `metric_from_database`, `metrics`, `profile`, `metric_cube`,
`rate_metrics`, `cohort_metrics`, `freshness`, `reconcile`, `asof_join`,
`window_mutate`, `recursive_cte`, `graph_analyze`, `diff`, and `sql`.

Native output and sessions (0.4.0): `to_parquet`, `to_csv`, `to_json`,
`to_table`, `to_view`, `to_arrow`, `to_polars`, `write_relation`,
`connect`, `attach`, `detach`, `tables`, `databases`, `show`, `glimpse`,
`count`, `sample`, `sample_rows`, `approx_distinct`, `approx_quantile`,
`register_python_function`, `apply_python_function`, `to_struct`,
`from_struct`, `to_list`, `from_list`, `unnest`, `list_transform`,
`list_filter`, `json_extract`.
